upstream.note: Structured incident metadata + factual summaries; every row deep-links the original.

incidents.title: Nikkei (Nihon Keizai Shimbun): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Nikkei reported that approximately 5.4 million personal records were leaked due to unauthorised access to an external service provider. The breach was disclosed on 27 November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: GMO Pepabo: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. GMO Pepabo reported that unauthorised access to its systems leaked over 510,000 user records from its rental server and cloud services, including some passwords. The incident was disclosed on 27 November 2026. Fukuoka, Japan.

incidents.title: Daimaru Matsuzakaya Department Store: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Daimaru Matsuzakaya Department Store reported that information from its online store leaked, totalling more than 880,000 records. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Osaka, Japan.

incidents.title: Minkabu: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Minkabu stated that unauthorised access may have leaked some customers' asset amounts. The company disclosed this possibility on 27 November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Monex Securities: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Monex Securities reported that identity-verification documents were leaked and offered ¥5,000 compensation to affected customers. The disclosure date was 27 November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.victim: KOFST (Korea Scientists and Engineers Mutual-Aid Association)
incidents.title: KOFST (Korea Scientists and Engineers Mutual-Aid Association): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. KOFST disclosed that a cyberattack leaked roughly 210,000 member records across 16 data categories, including encrypted resident registration numbers and home addresses. The attack occurred on 8 November and was publicly disclosed on 27 November 2026. Seoul, South Korea.

incidents.title: Korea Post (Internet Post Office): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Korea Post's Internet Post Office said that a hacking attack using overseas IP addresses exposed the names, addresses and phone numbers of registered-mail customers. Analysis of a single day's data alone identified 113,855 affected customers. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Seoul, South Korea.

incidents.title: StudySmarter: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. StudySmarter disclosed a serious cyberattack in which email addresses and password hashes were stolen, with millions of users worldwide told to change their passwords. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Munich, Germany.

incidents.title: Planet IC: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Planet IC, an IT service provider in Schwerin, suffered unauthorised access to its servers on the evening of 21 November, knocking out numerous client websites. Customer data of the energy supplier WEMAG was probably stolen. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Schwerin, Germany.

incidents.title: Department for Work and Pensions (DWP): Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The Department for Work and Pensions took nearly all online pensions and benefits services offline as a precaution after identifying a cyber incident affecting its systems. The department stated there was no evidence of customer data loss and that regular benefit and pension payments would continue as normal. London, United Kingdom.

incidents.title: FANCL: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. FANCL disclosed that a third party gained unauthorised access to a contractor's database containing counselling data from its in-store Skin Check Scope service leaking 148,393 measurement data records. Names and credit card information were not among the leaked items. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: YKK AP: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. YKK AP reported that 489 individuals were affected through contractor JP Tokyo & Company via its Otameshi Reform app service which was suspended. The disclosure was made on 27 November. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Barclays Bank Delaware: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Barclays Bank Delaware reported a breach involving a credit card application status system that exposed names contact details dates of birth and Social Security numbers. Wilmington Delaware is the location. Wilmington, United States.

incidents.title: Clayton: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Clayton Corporation sent notices dated 4 November 2026 to current and former employees saying files accessed in a data security incident may have held their Social Security numbers driver’s licence numbers and direct deposit bank details. Fenton Missouri is the location. United States.

incidents.title: Port Authority of Livorno: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The Port Authority of Livorno suffered an external intrusion on Sunday afternoon that locked up and crashed its IT infrastructure. Computers at Palazzo Rosciano and other operational offices were disconnected. Livorno, Italy.

incidents.title: Kinatico: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Kinatico Limited reported a cybersecurity breach impacting its Cited™ platform with personal data of 320 individuals compromised. The announcement was made on 27 November. Melbourne, Australia.

incidents.title: Dirección General de Casinos: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The Dirección General de Casinos suspended some administrative operations and temporarily closed two venues as a precaution. Montevideo is the location. Montevideo, Uruguay.

incidents.title: Mitsui Shopping Park: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Mitsui Shopping Park disclosed that unauthorised access to its app resulted in approximately 3.12 million members' personal information, including names, addresses and phone numbers, leaking. The disclosure was made on November 27, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: SAP SE: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. SAP SE confirmed a security incident it refers to internally as 'Project Granite', reporting no evidence of unauthorised access to customer business data. Reports indicated hackers may have accessed SAP's source code using compromised employee credentials or tokens. Germany.

incidents.title: Shueisha: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Shueisha announced that an external 'KARTE' service used for email distribution and part of its app was subjected to unauthorized access, leaking more than 700,000 records including birth dates. The incident was disclosed on November 26, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Beegle: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Beegle reported unauthorised access to the external KARTE service which led to a data leak. The disclosure occurred on 26 November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: New Balance Japan: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. New Balance Japan disclosed that unauthorised access to the KARTE service resulted in up to approximately 3.74 million records, including about 120,000 email addresses, leaking. The disclosure was made on November 26, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Sports Mania: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Sports Mania reported that unauthorised access to an external service resulted in a personal data leak. The incident was disclosed on 26 November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Shikoku Electric Power: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Electric utility Shikoku Electric Power disclosed that unauthorised access at a web contractor resulted in a further 250,000 records leaking. The incident is part of the wider KARTE supply-chain compromise. Takamatsu, Japan.

incidents.title: Medical System Network: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Medical System Network disclosed a personal-data leak at GoQSystem, the order-management contractor for its Healthcare Koyama business. The incident was reported on 26 November 2026. Sapporo, Japan.

incidents.title: Agence France-Presse: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Agence France-Presse isolated its Forum subscriber platform after an attack at about 01:30 Paris time on 26 November. The agency temporarily disabled its client platform for distributing news, photographs and video. Paris, France.

incidents.title: Canton of Basel: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. A cyberattack compromised approximately 97,000 work-permit records for cross-border commuters issued over the past ten years. The attack affected French and German frontier workers. Basel, Switzerland.

incidents.title: OPCO EP: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. OPCO EP confirmed a cybersecurity incident and suspended four digital portals on November 26, 2026. No data theft was confirmed and no attacker claim was identified. Paris, France.

incidents.title: Buffalo Grill: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Buffalo Grill confirmed a security incident exposing customer personal data after unauthorized access at its provider Brevo. Names, email addresses and phone numbers were involved, with no bank data compromised. Brétigny-sur-Orge, France.

incidents.title: Interservices: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Interservices confirmed unauthorised access to an old management application at its hosting provider, potentially exposing passwords, IBANs, quotes and invoices. The group Lunarissec claimed data on over 1 million people. Carcassonne, France.

incidents.title: Pagès: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Pagès confirmed a cyberattack on its online shop between November 20 and 23, 2026, where a flaw at a technical provider allowed access to personal data and order histories. A malicious script was injected on shop pages. France.

incidents.title: Direction générale de l'aviation civile: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. France's civil aviation authority DGAC confirmed a cyberattack causing a significant personal-data leak, with bank data stolen from a State payment site. The full scope is under review. France.

incidents.title: Mizuho Bank: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Mizuho Bank disclosed that 30,000 customer management numbers leaked after unauthorised access at a contractor. The incident is linked to the broader KARTE supply-chain compromise. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: CyberStep Holdings: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. CyberStep Holdings disclosed that online-game prize-shipping data via contractor OpenLogi resulted in 31,730 records leaking. The disclosure was made on November 26, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: CJ Olive Young: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Health and beauty retail CJ Olive Young disclosed unauthorised access to a work system on November 23, 2026, affecting 790 people's personal data plus 2,344,549 member-number records and 61,789 member-number-plus-IP records. The disclosure was made on November 26, 2026. Seoul, South Korea.

incidents.title: DigiCert: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Certificate authority DigiCert confirmed a data breach after an internal archive system was left internet-reachable; business contact data and some customer ID documents were readable. Customers began receiving notifications in the window. Lehi, United States.

incidents.title: World: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. World Co. published new details of leaked personal information through KARTE, reporting roughly 9 million records including online-store member email addresses. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Enara Health: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Enara Health reported a data breach affecting 5,066 individuals, confirmed via regulatory filing on November 26. United States.

incidents.title: Danawa: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 26 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. E-commerce and price comparison platform Danawa suspected an intrusion leading to a full service shutdown. Leak status is under investigation. The incident was logged on November 26, 2026. Seoul, South Korea.

incidents.title: Create: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 26 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Create disclosed unauthorized access to its invoice-download site, resulting in the leakage of 2,764 records. The Japanese service company is investigating the incident. Japan.

incidents.title: AFC: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 26 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. AFC disclosed unauthorized use of an admin account on its official online shop, putting up to 302,580 customers' data at risk. The health products retailer is investigating the incident. Japan.

incidents.title: Hiroshima Shudo University: Systems taken offline as a precaution
incidents.description: Systems taken offline as a precaution on 26 Nov 2026. No compromise has been stated. Hiroshima Shudo University disclosed personal and account information as a precaution. The disclosure was made on November 26, 2026. Hiroshima, Japan.

incidents.title: Intelcia: Claimed by Lulzsec/0xznetr/Babibi/GhostHunters, not confirmed
incidents.description: Lulzsec/0xznetr/Babibi/GhostHunters claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 26 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Intelcia was the subject of a data-leak claim covering approximately 96,300 employees and former employees, with names, email addresses, internal employee numbers and internal document names and metadata allegedly exposed. The archive is dated 22 November and the claim, attributed to actors using the names Lulzsec, 0xznetr, Babibi and GhostHunters, was reported on 26 November. Paris, France.

incidents.title: Mattel: Claimed by Inception, not confirmed
incidents.description: Inception claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 26 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Inception listed Mattel a US toy manufacturing company on its leak site alleging vehicle product-design and development records were stolen. The victim has not confirmed the claim. El Segundo, United States.

incidents.title: Eversource: Claimed by Whitearmor, not confirmed
incidents.description: Whitearmor claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 26 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Whitearmor claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Eversource a US utility company threatening to publish sensitive data. The victim has not confirmed the claim. United States.

incidents.title: Restaurant Brands International: Claimed by Inception, not confirmed
incidents.description: Inception claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 26 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Group Inception claims it stole 234 GB of data from Restaurant Brands International including personal info of over 126,000 US Burger King customers and partial card data. RBI had not confirmed the claim. Toronto, Canada.

incidents.title: Paramount: Claimed by Inception, not confirmed
incidents.description: Inception claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 26 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Inception claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Paramount a US media company threatening to publish sensitive data. The victim has not confirmed the claim. New York City, United States.

incidents.title: Verisk: Claimed by Inception, not confirmed
incidents.description: Inception claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 26 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Inception claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Verisk a US data analytics and insurance company threatening to publish sensitive data. The victim has not confirmed the claim. Jersey City, United States.

incidents.title: FYE: Claimed by Anubis, not confirmed
incidents.description: Anubis claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 26 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Anubis claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against FYE a US retail company threatening to publish sensitive data. The victim has not confirmed the claim. Salt Lake City, United States.

incidents.title: Groupe Antilles-Glaces: Claimed by Rhysida, not confirmed
incidents.description: Rhysida claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 26 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Rhysida claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Groupe Antilles-Glaces a Guadeloupe food production company threatening to publish sensitive data. The victim has not confirmed the claim. Guadeloupe.
